name: Github Action Merge Dependabot
description: Automatically approve and merge dependabot PRs

exclude.description: Packages that you want to manually review before upgrading

approve-only.description: If true, the PR is only approved but not merged

merge-method.description: The merge method you would like to use (squash, merge, rebase)

merge-comment.description: An arbitrary message that you'd like to comment on the PR after it gets auto-merged

use-github-auto-merge.description: If true, the PR is only marked as auto-merge enabled

target.description: Auto-merge on updates based on Semantic Versioning

target-development.description: Auto-merge on updates based on Semantic Versioning for development dependencies

target-production.description: Auto-merge on updates based on Semantic Versioning for production dependencies

target-indirect.description: Auto-merge on updates based on Semantic Versioning for indirect updates

pr-number.description: A pull request number, only required if triggered from a workflow_dispatch event

skip-commit-verification.description: If true, then the action will not expect the commits to have a verification signature. It is required to set this to true in GitHub Enterprise Server

skip-verification.description: If true, the action will not validate the user or the commit verification status

merge-window.description: A 5-field cron expression (e.g. "0 9-16 * * 1-5") describing when merges are allowed. PRs evaluated outside this window are skipped.

merge-window-timezone.description: The IANA timezone (e.g. "Europe/London") used to evaluate merge-window. Defaults to UTC.
